definitions.explanation: A person or entity that holds power and exercises control over others, whether in politics, society, or a more abstract or figurative sense.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{支配者|しはいしゃ}だ。
examples.english: He is the ruler of this country.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{支配者|しはいしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}った→握る：02383_nigiru⟧。
⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{支配者|しはいしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{興|おこ}り、⟦そして→そして：00997_soshite⟧{滅|ほろ}んでいった。
examples.english: Throughout history, many rulers rose to power and then perished.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{支配|しはい}→支配：01421_shihai⟧ (rule, control, domination) and ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Refers to someone who holds authority and exercises control. Can be used for historical rulers, political leaders, or figuratively for anyone who dominates a situation or domain.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{絶対的|ぜったいてき}→絶対的：05849_zettaiteki⟧な{支配者|しはいしゃ}: absolute ruler
- {支配者|しはいしゃ}⟦{層|そう}→層：12441_sou⟧: ruling class
- {支配者|しはいしゃ}⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧: the ruling side

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{統治者|とうちしゃ}→統治者：23032_touchisha⟧: governor, ruler — emphasizes the act of governing or administering; more formal and institutional
- ⟦{権力者|けんりょくしゃ}→権力者：17021_kenryokusha⟧: person of power — focuses on having power rather than exercising control
- ⟦{独裁者|どくさいしゃ}→独裁者：15406_dokusaisha⟧: dictator — specifically an authoritarian ruler with absolute power
